blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein ulta kaam hai: vector ki lambai pehle se di hui hai, aur components mein ek unknown \(t\) chhupa hai.
Diya kya hai? \(|2\underline{i} + (t - 1)\underline{j} + t\underline{k}| = \sqrt{13}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(t\) ki woh tamam values jin se lambai \(\sqrt{13}\) bane.
Plan: magnitude ka formula likhenge, dono taraf square karenge taake square root khatam ho, aur jo quadratic equation bane usay solve karenge. Quadratic hai, to do jawab aa sakte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|2\underline{i} + (t - 1)\underline{j} + t\underline{k}| = \sqrt{13}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(t\).
Tareeqa: Magnitude formula \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}\) lagayenge. Dono sides par square root hai, square karne se dono hat jayenge aur \(t\) ki quadratic equation reh jayegi.

Magnitude likhein
\[\sqrt{2^2 + (t - 1)^2 + t^2} = \sqrt{13}\]
Kyun: Components hain \(x = 2\), \(y = t - 1\), \(z = t\). Inhi ko formula mein rakha; \(t - 1\) ko poora bracket mein rakhna zaroori hai kyunke poore component ka square lena hai.

Dono sides ka square
\[4 + (t - 1)^2 + t^2 = 13\]
Kyun: Dono sides positive hain (lambai kabhi negative nahi hoti), is liye square karne se koi naya ghalat jawab paida nahi hota. Square root aur square ek dusre ko khatam kar dete hain.

Expand kar ke terms ikatthe karein
\[4 + t^2 - 2t + 1 + t^2 = 13\]
\[2t^2 - 2t + 5 - 13 = 0\]
\[2t^2 - 2t - 8 = 0\]
\[t^2 - t - 4 = 0\]
Kyun: \((t - 1)^2 = t^2 - 2t + 1\) formula \((a - b)^2\) se aaya. Phir \(t^2\) wale terms jama kiye, constants \(4 + 1 - 13 = -8\), aur poori equation ko 2 se divide kar ke chhota kiya.
Dhyan dein: \((t - 1)^2\) ko \(t^2 - 1\) likhna aam ghalti hai; beech wala \(-2t\) mat bhooliye.

Quadratic formula lagayein
\[t = \dfrac{1 \pm \sqrt{1 + 16}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 \pm \sqrt{17}}{2}\]
Kyun: Yeh equation aasaani se factorize nahi hoti (aise do whole numbers nahi jin ka product \(-4\) aur jama \(-1\) ho), is liye formula \(t = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\) lagaya: \(a = 1\), \(b = -1\), \(c = -4\), discriminant \(1 + 16 = 17\).

Tasdeeq
\[t^2 = t + 4 \text{ for both roots}\]
\[4 + (t - 1)^2 + t^2 = 2t^2 - 2t + 5\]
\[= 2(t + 4) - 2t + 5 = 13 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono roots \(t^2 - t - 4 = 0\) ko satisfy karti hain, yani \(t^2 = t + 4\). Yeh rakhne se lambai ka square bilkul 13 aata hai, chahe koi bhi root ho. Is liye dono jawab sahi hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(t = \frac{1 \pm \sqrt{17}}{2}\)
Do values hain, aur dono se vector ki lambai \(\sqrt{13}\) banti hai.
